openai.notes: 2026-10-29: added gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-6-luna (flagships) and gpt-6-sol (superseded by 6.1 Sol, not deprecated) — limits/features from each model's own page. gpt-5.4-nano deprecated (shutdown 2027-04-01) but still serving, kept last. No gpt-6-terra exists on vendor docs; *-pro variants still out of scope.

anthropic.notes: 2026-10-29: added claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5 (all 1M/128K); 'file' input + structured outputs/code execution confirmed via supportedModels lists on pdf-support, structured-outputs and code-execution-tool pages. All 6 prior models still Active. Claude Mythos 5.1 not added (verification-program gated).

google.notes: 2026-10-29: added gemini-4-argon and gemini-3.8-flash (per-model pages). gemini-4-argon maxOutputTokens is the 65,536 synchronous limit; up to 1M needs long decode via background Interactions API (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/long-decode). gemini-3.7-flash/gemini-3.5-flash are deprecated but not shut down (API auto-routes to 3.8/3.6 Flash), kept. Live/TTS/image/music models still out of scope.

zhipu.notes: 2026-10-29: added glm-5.3-flashx to ZAI_MODELS (same guide page as glm-5.3-flash: 1M/128K, text+image+video+file). Not added: glm-5.3-flashx-legal (enterprise application only), glm-5.3-prime (no vendor doc), glm-5v-turbo/glm-4.6v (vision line never in scope). bigmodel.cn model-overview still lists glm-5-turbo and glm-4-long, so kept. Coding Plan still only GLM-5.3 + GLM-5.3-Flash (FlashX not on plan).

minimax.notes: 2026-10-29: added MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (2026-10-19; 1M ctx, max_completion_tokens max 524288, text+image+video). Removed M2.1, M2.1-highspeed, M2, M2-her (faq/models 'Retired Models'). M2.5/M2.7 (+highspeed) also listed as retired there, but the same page's notice says PAYG existing users keep access until 2026-11-18 and plan requests route to M3.1 Flash — kept for now; remove after 2026-11-18.

deepseek.notes: 2026-10-29: added deepseek-flash (V4.1 Flash, now DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; 1M/384K, JSON output + tool calls + vision per pricing table). OpenRouter's deepseek-v4.1-flash is NOT a vendor id. V4 Flash / V4 Flash Vision Exp are retired but their ids are 'temporarily routed' to V4.1 Flash, so kept as lowest-priority entries — remove once DeepSeek drops the compat routing. deepseek-v4-pro unchanged.

openrouter.notes: Scripted (npm run fetch-openrouter-models), not hand-verified from vendor docs.

novita-ai.notes: Scripted (npm run fetch-novita-models). Filters to status === 1, an inferred heuristic (not documented by Novita) for 'currently active' — re-verify if the ratio of status !== 1 entries changes drastically. No public embeddings-listing endpoint found; embeddingModels intentionally left unset.

kimi.notes: 2026-10-29: added kimi-k3.1-pro/-highspeed; removed kimi-k2.5 + moonshot-v1 series (CN model list: '已于 2026 年 8 月 31 日下线'). kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed modalities/structuredOutputs left unset — vision guide and structured-output examples only name kimi-k3.1-pro. Coding: added k3.1-pro/k3.1-pro-highspeed; kimi-for-coding now maps to K2.8 Preview with 1M context. K2 series (k2.6/k2.7-code) closed to new users 2026-10-31, retiring end of Dec 2026.
